sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.
Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: No controlled record gives a part approval for Meccanica Chisone on PN-050 at any receiving plant or customer. The only approvals mentioned are for aluminium 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The supplier is approved again as a company, but that does not release this part. The absence of a record is not proof it is not approved, so a person must confirm. The customer for PRG-X is also not given in the documents.

sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: The drawing requires steel 42CrMo4. Chisone is listed as an aluminium extrusion and blank supplier. No 3.1 certificate for 42CrMo4 from Chisone is in the documents, and nothing shows they can supply this material. A person must provide it.
